claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User accesses the Reports (Standard and Customized) module to generate the provider reimbursement report for the reporting period.
The user selects a VSP/provider for whom the reimbursement report is to be generated.
The system retrieves the selected provider's processed claim information from the Database.
The system displays the selected VSP's Claim Status details, including Claim No, Date, Amount, and Status.
The system displays the Cumulative Total Amount for previous payments in the report footer.

The user requests generation of the bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical provider reimbursement report on claims per provider, based on the VSP payment terms, using the standard report format specified for MSIU.
The system generates the provider reimbursement report on claims per provider from the processed claim data stored in the Database.

claims.content: To generate the bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical provider reimbursement reports on claims per provider, using standard or customized report formats as specified for MSIU.
The VSP's collected claim forms have been received by the MSIU Field Office and processed.
The VSP payment terms that govern the bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical reports have been agreed.
The required provider reimbursement report specification is established as per the MSIU Project Document 'Programme Design Study'.
The MSIU Field Office User accesses the Reports (Standard and Customized) module to generate the provider reimbursement report for the reporting period.
The user selects a VSP/provider for whom the reimbursement report is to be generated.
The system retrieves the selected provider's processed claim information from the Database.
The system displays the selected VSP's Claim Status details, including Claim No, Date, Amount, and Status.
The system displays the Cumulative Total Amount for previous payments in the report footer.

The user requests generation of the bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical provider reimbursement report on claims per provider, based on the VSP payment terms, using the standard report format specified for MSIU.
The system generates the provider reimbursement report on claims per provider from the processed claim data stored in the Database.

If the report required for the reporting period must be produced in a customized format rather than the standard report format, the system generates the customized financial and medical provider reimbursement report.

If the payment terms agreed by the VSP call for a bi-monthly reporting period rather than a monthly one, the bi-monthly financial and medical provider reimbursement report is generated for that period.

The system generates a report on claims where payment shall be withheld until clarification; after generating the reports, the MSIU Field Office User sends them to the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for the VSP.
The required bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical provider reimbursement reports on claims per provider have been generated from the processed claim data stored in the Database.
The Cumulative Total Amount for the previous payment done is shown in the report footer.
